messages:
sam (Procure): MeterTrace sent renewal + new reseller routing clause. They want to route EU invoices via a partner and added a 'dedupe service' line. Can legal/finance skim?

ana (Finance): Paste topline numbers plz. reseller + dedupe svc = risky for landed cost.

sam (Procure): Quote: commit $26k/mo (1.4B net tokens), metered $0.021/1k, dedupe svc $800/mo if enabled, reseller routing adds VAT complexity.

mike (Platform): Important: does dedupe svc overlap with our client dedupe? ask if vendor dedupe is global, window size, fuzzy matching, and whether dedupe svc is mandatory for commit.

ana (Finance): If reseller changes invoicing entity we need VAT reg and reverse-charge options. Also model both with and without dedupe svc.

sam (Procure): Messaged sales: "Confirm: is dedupe svc mandatory for commit pricing? Will reseller be optional? Provide VAT reg number, sample invoice showing reseller pass-through, and sample redacted dedupe report (hashed tokens + counts)."

billing-bot: BillingOps note: last MeterTrace invoice INV-2026-07 had a 8% variance vs our records; ticket #2110 open.

tara (Legal): Contract asks: 1) no mandatory reseller routing; 2) reseller must disclose markup; 3) right to audit redacted dedupe logs monthly; 4) define 'net tokens' in SOW.

mike (Platform): We need dedupe sample format (parquet preferred) and TTL/window detail. If they can't provide hashed prefixes we can't validate.

sam (Procure): Vendor replied: "Dedupe svc is optional; commit price assumes it's enabled. Reseller is optional. We'll provide VAT details and can drop reseller if you prefer direct invoice. Monthly redacted parquet feed available; window = 30d by default; per-tenant dedupe with exact + fuzzy threshold configurable."

an (Finance): Good. Tara 1 will you add audit clause + true-up cadence? Mike 1 can you validate parquet schema for our recon pipeline?

tara (Legal): Will add audit + quarterly true-up + materiality threshold for misbilling credits. No mandatory reseller.

sam (Procure): TL;DR: Vendor ok to direct invoice, dedupe svc optional (but commit assumes enabled). Need platform to validate feed and finance to model with $800/mo dedupe svc. If feed/audit + true-up OK -> commit looks viable. Otherwise default to metered with caps.
